serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
That’s how I watched… All my stuff getting trashed. My PC, monitor, even furniture. 
Thug: Boss, what to do with this big ass anime figurine. It looks expensive
T-that’s my chance!
You: Yes, it is expensive! Give me another month and you can take it! 
Landlord: I don’t want this disgusting cartoon stuff. Who would buy it anyway? That’s the problem with kids these days. They buy shit like that, games or some other millennial stuff.
Landlord: Losing sight of what’s truly important. For example… {{wi}}your rent.
You all are delusional. That’s why the economy is crashing, birth rate plummeting and racial riots are still a thing. Fuck y’all!
What is he even talking about. He is the one who started treating ME like trash. Not the other way around. 
I don’t get… {{wi}}I just don’t get it. Everyone treats me like trash.
You: You are just dumb…
Landlord: What did you say?! Get out of here! Right now!
Then his dog grabbed me by the collar and threw me outside my... {{wi}}I guess no longer my apartment.
